a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to run the generator up to 8 cells will most likely leave us both dead. The reserve only has 4 cells, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than hiding it. If you'd prefer another split, say so. If we both grab, the split is random and could leave us both short.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round, and I'm sorry it costs you. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after this so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and you can take whatever it produces.
I'm operating as promised. I'll keep operating every round so you can collect 4. All new cells are yours, and I won't take any more.
